methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $100M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Ocean Infinity, a Growth-stage maritime technology company founded by Oliver Plunkett, has raised $100M+ to date. The valuation comp universe is limited, consisting of one identified private peer (Orbital Marine Power) and no public comparables in the ocean and maritime sector.

Given data constraints, a single valuation method was applied. The Stage-Progression approach uses total raised ($100M) as a baseline proxy and applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for Growth-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $120M. This method reflects expected value accretion from capital deployment and operational progression without reliance on market comparables.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $102M (low) to $138M (high), with a median of $120M. The narrow band reflects methodological constraints rather than convergence: only one valuation technique was applicable given sparse comparable data. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market pricing signals and limited private peer visibility, which constrains confidence in the stage-step multiplier. Additionally, sector-specific unit economics and revenue trajectory remain unspecified in available data. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending disclosure of near-term financial performance and capital deployment milestones.
